text: Maybe it depends on the hospital, but you don't really have to do it in advance. In Ichilov they just take your credit card details as a deposit, and after you get back home, you'll have a couple of weeks to get this form and forward it to the hospital. My memory is a little hazy, but it wasn't stressful at all. We did not get this form on purpose, because we were choosing hospital until the last moment...
